summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by NatWest Group plc disclosing a routine PDMR share sale under the UK Market Abuse Regulation. The filing reports that PDMR Scott Marcar sold 251,868 ordinary shares at £6.3449 per share on 19 June 2026 on the London Stock Exchange. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or tender offer is involved. The transaction is a standard insider sale notification with no board recommendation, advisor, or structural complexity. This is a routine current report, not a special situation.
